tools.name: inspect_target
tools.description: Inspects BUILD.gn and BUILD.bazel in the target directory

tools.name: find_rdeps
tools.description: Finds true reverse dependencies across BUILD.gn and BUILD.bazel (excluding visibility allowlists and GN-only sentinel targets; references to generated <target>_<suffix> sub-targets such as fidl_library bindings <fidl>_rust count toward the owning target) and computes per-target 3-tier visibility recommendations (tight :__pkg__/LCA for narrow targets, 2-3 level subsystem area rollups for multi-subsystem targets, and //:__subpackages__ for foundational tree-wide libraries; never //visibility:public outside //build/bazel_sdk/...)

tools.name: run_checks
tools.description: Runs the checks in checks/manifest.json exactly the way planter runs them after the coder reports (same scripts, environment, parsing and severities) and prints the findings; exits 1 if any ERROR or WARNING would send the change back. --skip-build runs only the static checks (seconds); a run without it also builds, after waiting for a machinery evolution in progress. --only NAMES runs a subset, --json prints the findings array.
